ledger: skateboard | intact black deck with two silver trucks and four white wheels on concrete under skater's feet at 00:00 | warped and split into two disconnected deck fragments at 00:09 | popped into the air and landed intact (00:01-00:03), popped into the air again at 00:08 where trucks/wheels deform and vanish, then deck splits into two separate pieces at 00:09

findings.description: While the skateboard is mid-air during the second jump at 00:08, its left truck and wheels vanish/deform into the deck while the right truck morphs into a single thin stem; by 00:09, the intact skateboard deck splits and warps into two disconnected fragments beneath the skater's feet without a physical break.
